_comment: Human-editable deal source. The Decap portal at /admin edits THIS file. scripts/build-promotions.mjs expands it into data/promotions.json, which the site reads. Do not edit promotions.json by hand.

deals.headline: Buy 3 Get 1 Free, mix and match
deals.description: Instant Peptides is running a Buy 3 Get 1 Free mix and match promotion from Monday July 21 through Sunday July 26, ending 11:59pm Eastern. Any 3 products qualify, they do not need to match, and the free item is applied automatically in the cart with no code required. Code SAMMYC still applies on top for its standing 15% off, which is the same rate it gives outside the sale. Every order placed during the sale is entered into the vendor Build-A-Kit giveaway, with 3 winners selected at random by Instant Peptides. Giveaway terms, eligibility and winner selection are handled entirely by the vendor.
